kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
استحببت (form X)
# اِسْتَحْبَبْتُ (istaḥbabtu) /is.taħ.bab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَحَبَّ (istaḥabba)
# اِسْتَحْبَبْتَ (istaḥbabta) /is.taħ.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَحَبَّ (istaḥabba)
# اِسْتَحْبَبْتِ (istaḥbabti) /is.taħ.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَحَبَّ (istaḥabba)
# اُسْتُحْبِبْتُ (ustuḥbibtu) /us.tuħ.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
